newsitem.title: USA: Unapix to invest in Centauro.
newsitem.headline: Unapix to invest in Centauro.

text.p: Unapix Entertainment Inc said on Friday it has signed a letter of intent to buy an initial 20 percent ownership interest in Centauro Communicaciones SA, a private firm specializing in distribution and sound dubbing of entertainment programs for Hispanic markets.
The total value of the investment was not disclosed.

Centauro, based in Bogota, Colombia, distributes entertainment programs in Latin and South America and in the United States, and operates sound-dubbing facilities that service major movie studios, Unapix said.

Unapix, which expects to raise its stake in Centauro to 50 percent, and Centauro have also agreed to enter into a joint venture for the development, production and acquisition of film and television properties.

Unapix's investment will be used by Centauro for a major expansion of its dubbing facilities and added working capital. Also, the two companies will form a venture for film and television program distribution in Latin American markets.
